lines.text: Twenty-eight premiers crus. Not one grand cru.
lines.phonemes: twˈɛntiˈeɪt pɹˌɛmjeɪ kɹˈuː. nˌɑːt wˈʌn ɡɹˈɑːn kɹˈuː.

lines.text: Three hundred thirty-six hectares, by Beaune.
lines.phonemes: θɹˈiː hˈʌndɹɪd θˈɜːɾisˈɪks hˈɛktɛɹz, baɪ bˈoʊn.

lines.text: Two hundred seventy-six metres up, facing south-east.
lines.phonemes: tˈuː hˈʌndɹɪd sˈɛvəntisˈɪks mˈiːɾɚz ˈʌp, fˈeɪsɪŋ sˈaʊθˈiːst.

lines.text: Clay and limestone. In places, red with iron.
lines.phonemes: klˈeɪ ænd lˈaɪmstoʊn. ɪn plˈeɪsᵻz, ɹˈɛd wɪð ˈaɪɚn.

lines.text: Seven hundred fifty-three millimetres of rain a year at Savigny. Dijon gets seven hundred forty-three.
lines.phonemes: sˈɛvən hˈʌndɹɪd fˈɪftiθɹˈiː mˈɪlɪmˌiːɾɚz ʌv ɹˈeɪn ɐ jˈɪɹ æt sævinjˈiː. dˈiːʒɑːn ɡˈɛts sˈɛvən hˈʌndɹɪd fˈɔːɹɾiθɹˈiː.

lines.text: Forty-nine frost days a year. Dijon, further north, has more than sixty.
lines.phonemes: fˈɔːɹtinˈaɪn fɹˈɔst dˈeɪz ɐ jˈɪɹ. dˈiːʒɑːn, fˈɜːðɚ nˈɔːɹθ, hɐz mˈɔːɹ ðɐn sˈɪksti.

lines.text: Pinot Noir, with at least nine thousand vines per hectare.
lines.phonemes: pˈiːnoʊ nwˈɑːɹ, wɪð æt lˈiːst nˈaɪn θˈaʊzənd vˈaɪnz pɜː hˈɛktɛɹ.

lines.phonemes: jˈiːldz ɑːɹ kˈæpt æt fˈɪftiˈeɪt hˈɛktəlˌiːɾɚz pɜː hˈɛktɛɹ.
